2. End-to-End Enterprise ComfyUI Video Recasting, Audio Synthesis & Short-Drama Architecture
Four-Pillar Studio: Auto-Drama Web Console ➔ Body Double Recasting ➔ Higgs v3 100-Lang TTS ➔ ComfyUI-Doctor Live Ops
Pillar A: Body Double Recaster (open-source-higgsfield)
• Follow-Cam Virtual Crop: SAM 3.1 tracks performer & renders
a tight virtual camera so SCAIL-2 never degrades on small actors
• Pixel-Identical Background Plate: Pastes only the recast
performer back into the untouched 1080p plate (set & grain stay)
• Open-Weights Trio: SAM 3.1 + FLUX 3 Image Klein + SCAIL-2
• Occlusion Re-ID: Automatically re-identifies actor after cuts
• License: Permissive Apache-2.0 open-weights workflow
✓ Replaces closed Higgsfield Genjutsu credits with local GPUs
Pillar B: 100-Lang Dialogue TTS (Higgs_v3-TTS-ComfyUI)
• Backbone: bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b (Qwen3 + audio head)
• Zero-Shot Voice Cloning: Standard ComfyUI AUDIO in/out with
Whisper auto-transcription for high-fidelity reference lock
• Inline Director Tags: Emotion, speaking style, prosody & SFX
• Multi-Speaker & Longform: Turn-by-turn dialogue synthesis +
long-script chunking + ComfyUI/AIMDO DynamicVRAM offloading
• Governance Note: Node is MIT; Higgs v3 weights = non-commercial
✓ Native multi-speaker dubbing directly inside ComfyUI graphs
Pillar C: Short-Drama Factory (qiukaihui/comfyui-auto-drama)
• Zero-Dependency Web Console: Pure Python stdlib + SQLite
• Structured Prompt Compiler: 3-stage narrative + 6-stage R2V
prompts with 4-view character turnarounds & scene anchors
• Remote MiniMax H3 Engine: T2V / I2V / Ref2VA with native
stereo audio, nvfp4 text encoder, TurboLoRA & SageAttention
• Automated VLM QA & Final Cut: Multimodal quality gate +
one-click subtitle burn-in, CTA overlay & audio pop stripping
✓ Automates episodic short-drama production from script to MP4
Pillar D: Live Diagnostics Suite (rookiestar28/ComfyUI-Doctor)
• Startup & Runtime Log Interception: Captures tracebacks and
pinpoints exact failing node IDs (including opaque/colon IDs)
• 50+ Hot-Reloadable JSON Fix Patterns: Instant remediation
for missing CUDA ops, shape mismatches & Branch node routing
• Security-Hardened UI: Treats special-character node IDs as
inert data (prevents DOM/attribute injection in Locate button)
• Global Team Support: 9-language i18n + interactive LLM chat
✓ Cuts ComfyUI custom-node crash recovery from hours to seconds
